author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Applies creator-authored Twitch, YouTube, and Kick channel profiles through one guarded shared Streamer.bot provider controller.
changelog: 4.1.8: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.1.8, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.2: initial release with three guided profiles, creator-only relay actions, source-verified provider title/category methods, one shared triggerless controller, simulation suppression, and bounded result audit.

manifest.name: Creator Controls
installationSteps: Import the bundled Creator Controls Streamer.bot package.
Turn on the add-on and edit only the stream profiles you plan to use.
Approve only its triggerless Provider Controller action in the wizard.
Connect Apply Profile 1, 2, or 3 to your matching creator-controlled scene trigger, hotkey, or deck button.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstall the add-on. A short record of its last result is kept for a later reinstall.

healthChecks.description: Confirms guarded creator profiles can use the shared provider controller.
